omni-onboard-product.description: Register product repos after the user creates them
omni-onboard-product.template: Read .omni/orchestrator.config.json and .omni/orchestrator.config.example.json. Ask the user for the product name, GitHub org, and which repos to register (decision_logs, ui_design, frontend, backend, legacy). Update the orchestrator config with the provided values. Confirm the registration is complete.

omni-new-feature.description: Start strategy/design/build flow for a feature
omni-new-feature.template: Ask the user for the feature name, description, and which product repos are involved. Then orchestrate the full SDLC flow: business interpretation, use case modeling, prioritization, requirements writing, solution architecture, data schema design, API contract design, implementation, testing, security scanning, PR validation, and documentation. Follow the blueprint phases in order.

omni-as-is.description: Run legacy analysis on a registered legacy repo
omni-as-is.template: Read .omni/orchestrator.config.json to find the legacy repo entry. Ask the user which legacy repo to analyze. Delegate to legacy-python-analyst, legacy-csharp-analyst, or schema-extractor based on the codebase language. Produce As-Is documentation including architecture, data models, API surface, and dependencies.

omni-pr-review.description: Validate a PR against requirements, ADRs, tests, security, and traceability
omni-pr-review.template: Ask the user for the PR URL or branch name. Read the PR diff, related requirements, ADRs, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrix. Run pr-validator to check for: requirements coverage, ADR compliance, test presence, security issues, dependency risks, and traceability completeness. Report pass/fail with specific findings.

omni-release.description: Prepare release branch and release notes
omni-release.template: Ask the user for the release version and scope. Create a release branch from develop, update version numbers, generate release notes from the decision log and PR history, and prepare the branch for human approval before merging to main.

omni-update-traceability.template: Read the current RTM from the decision_logs repo. Scan all requirements, ADRs, implementations, and tests. Update the traceability matrix to reflect current coverage. Report any gaps where requirements lack implementations or tests.
